title: An interrupt lands in the default handler
description: After relocating an application behind a bootloader, a UART interrupt enters the default handler. Provide an ordered investigation using the linker map, vector table address, handler symbol, interrupt number, and debugger register inspection.
prompt: After relocating an application behind a bootloader, a UART interrupt enters the default handler. Provide an ordered investigation using the linker map, vector table address, handler symbol, interrupt number, and debugger register inspection.
constraints: State assumptions and separate measurements from guarantees.
rubric: Verify the active vector table base where supported.
Check exact handler symbol and weak alias resolution.
Check interrupt index, enable state, and pending status without assuming one MCU's register layout.
follow_ups: What should be checked before jumping from bootloader to application?
How could a C++ linkage mismatch produce this symptom?
hints: Write down the boundary cases before choosing an implementation.
Use explicit integer widths and keep intermediate values in range.
